issue_request: FHIR-14712 was an Applied FHIR-I change request with Persuasive with Modification disposition. It asked to add US Core, US Meds, and other usage references for the CapabilityStatement search-parameter-combination extension; the final disposition rejected manually maintained usage lists and called for template/publisher rendering that links to an up-to-date cross-reference/statistics report.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-14712 was found. The relevant extension previously existed under source/capabilitystatement/structuredefinition-extension-capabilitystatement-search-parameter-combination.xml, but commit dd468d4f17 removed core extensions from the R5 source. Current core source search found only source/oids.ini retaining the extension URL.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes show the group discussing empty Extension Pack usage rendering in April and May 2023, then approving FHIR-14712 as Persuasive with Mod at the May 2023 WGM. The current Extension Pack source owns the StructureDefinition and builds with hl7.extensions.template#1.0.0. The rendered current page includes a FHIR IG Statistics usage link and local IG usage text; a curl check of that packages2 XIG target returned 404 during reconciliation, which would be external package-server/template work if still live.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The combined branch received an empty external-repo audit commit documenting that the actionable surface is outside HL7/fhir core.
